title: RFI Announces Bibisi as President
summary: RF Industries, a national manufacturer and marketer of interconnect products and systems, today announced the promotion of Ray Bibisi to President, adding to his current role of Chief Operating Officer.
body_markdown:
# RFI Announces Bibisi as President


- [View Larger Image](https://rfindustries.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/bibisi-editorial-image-800x377-1.jpg)


RF Industries announces the promotion of Ray Bibisi to President, adding to his current role of Chief Operating Officer, effective February 29, 2024.[READ THE FULL PRESS RELEASE](https://feeds.issuerdirect.com/news-release.html?newsid=6020702396423316)


[Paula Mennone-Preisner](https://rfindustries.com/author/pmpreisner/)


2024-02-29T07:33:03-08:00


February 29th, 2024


|
